verification_note: Both required interpreters were executed. CPython 3.8.10 on the validation host and CPython 3.11.16 in a clean python:3.11-slim container. With the frozen dependency pins the two produce identical audit output, so the interpreter is not a source of variation.
compatibility_rules: Every qa1b module begins with 'from __future__ import annotations' so PEP 604 unions in annotations never evaluate at runtime.
math.comb and http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer are the newest standard-library entry points used; both exist in 3.8.
runner_dependencies: scripts/api_runner_qa1.py, scripts/qa_runner.py, scripts/qa_core.py and the adapters use the standard library only.

reproducibility_finding.summary: The authoritative shortcut audit is not version-stable across scikit-learn major releases.

python_3.11.16 + scikit-learn 1.9.0.note: template_only transferable also rises from 0.204 to 0.400

reproducibility_finding.cause: LogisticRegression fitting behaviour differs between scikit-learn 1.3 and 1.9; the probe predictions change, not the audit method.
reproducibility_finding.consequence: The frozen verdict "pass with disclosed residual" holds only under the pinned stack. The pins are therefore part of the freeze, and any re-run must record them.
